official.deadline_note: No separate institutional deadline is published; the central calendar continues after the window closes: socioeconomic information on 17 December 2026, preselection and potential renewants results 15 January 2027, assignment results 10 March 2027, and appeal period 10 to 25 March 2027.
official.application_cycle: Admission 2027 cycle (primero periodo de postulacion, admision 2027)
official.status_note: The ChileAtiende ficha publishes the first application period for admission 2027 as 1 to 22 October 2026 through the FUAS website, and assignment/appeal/renewal results for admission 2026 from 15 October 2026; only the first period is published for 2027 admission.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Financia hasta $750.000 del arancel anual de la carrera, permitiendo financiar total o parcialmente el arancel anual. The arancel does not include the matricula (enrolment fee), per the Mineduc glossary.
benefits: Up to CLP 750,000 per year towards the annual tuition (arancel anual) of the continuation degree, financing all or part of it
Granted for the entire regulatory duration of the degree, according to the curriculum the institution provides each year
eligibility: Belong to the 70% most vulnerable according to the Registro Social de Hogares (RSH)
Have a secondary-school (ensenanza media) grade average of 5.0 or above
Be a graduate (egresada) or holder (titulada) of a higher technical career completed during 2025 and 2026
Not have received Mineduc tuition (arancel) scholarships as a first-year student on two separate occasions
Enrol at an institution accredited as at 31 December 2026; for Medicine, Dentistry or Pedagogy the degree itself must also be accredited
requirements: File the application through the FUAS website with RUT and password or ClaveUnica
The continuation degree must be an undergraduate (pregrado) presential programme at a university or professional institute
The professional degree must be in a field of knowledge related to the original technical career
Enter the professional degree for the year of benefit assignment, or from the second academic semester of the immediately preceding year

Enrol at an accredited institution; the benefit does not apply to distance, semi-presential, special titulacion, postgraduate, post-degree programmes, or any programme the institution defines as a special study plan
documents: Certificate of completion (certificado de egreso) or degree (titulacion) of the technical programme
Secondary-school grade average (NEM) available on the Mineduc Portal de Certificados en Linea, or requested through Ayuda Mineduc
Proof of enrolment at an accredited institution
Documents supporting the socioeconomic evaluation, if requested by the institution
selection_criteria: The benefit is granted on the basis of the data submitted when completing the FUAS, plus the information the State holds
coverage: Up to CLP 750,000 of the annual tuition (arancel anual) of the continuation degree
application_method: Complete the FUAS (Formulario Unico de Acreditacion Socioeconomica) online at postulacion.beneficiosestudiantiles.cl/fuas during the application period, using RUT and password or ClaveUnica
Review socioeconomic level information, preselection and final assignment results at resultados.beneficiosestudiantiles.cl with your RUT
official.application_route: Apply online through the FUAS during 1-22 October 2026, then track preselection and assignment results on the Beneficios Estudiantiles site.
official.study_mode: Presential (in-person) undergraduate study, as published; the official pages do not use the terms full-time or part-time
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The continuation professional degree must be in a field of knowledge related to the original technical career, be an undergraduate presential programme, and be excluded if the institution defines it as a special study plan; Medicine, Dentistry and Pedagogy degrees additionally require programme accreditation.
official.duration: The regulatory duration of the degree, as indicated in the curriculum provided each year by the institution; the titulacion period and professional or work placements do not count unless included in the curriculum.
official.description: Support from the Ministerio de Educacion for people who graduated from or completed a higher technical career during 2025 and 2026 and wish to continue studying to obtain a professional degree, financing all or part of the annual tuition up to a maximum of CLP 750,000.
official.program_type: Government tuition scholarship (beca de arancel), Ministerio de Educacion

verification.notes: Amount, coverage, requirements, duration, exclusions and the 2027 cycle calendar were confirmed on three official Mineduc-published pages (ChileAtiende ficha 17226, the Beneficios Estudiantiles BAR page, and Ayuda Mineduc), all stating up to CLP 750,000 of the annual arancel; the FUAS 2027 window was also visible on the official Beneficios Estudiantiles agenda. No English, citizenship or international-student rule is published on those pages.

applicant_utility.summary: The BAR pays up to CLP 750,000 a year of the arancel of your continuation degree for the full regulatory length of that degree, and it is aimed squarely at 2025-2026 graduates of Chilean higher technical careers. The single application route is the FUAS, open only from 1 to 22 October 2026 for the 2027 intake, so the form must be completed inside that window even though the benefit itself lasts years. Because only the arancel is touched, budget the matricula fee, any tuition above the cap, and all living costs yourself. Decisions run late: socioeconomic data lands on 17 December 2026 and final assignment on 10 March 2027, so hold your enrolment plan together until then.
applicant_utility.best_fit: 2025 or 2026 egresados or titulados of a Chilean tecnico de nivel superior in the 70% most vulnerable RSH bracket with a 5.0+ secondary average, moving into a related in-person professional degree.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your RSH tramo on Mi ChileAtiende with your ClaveUnica before the window opens, and confirm you sit inside the 70% most vulnerable group
Verify your NEM is downloadable from certificados.mineduc.cl; if it is missing, request it through Ayuda Mineduc or call 600 600 26 26 well before preselection
Obtain or activate your ClaveUnica and know your RUT and password before day one of the window
Confirm the target institution is accredited as at 31 December 2026 and, for Medicine, Dentistry or Pedagogy, that the specific degree is accredited
Open the FUAS early in October, complete every household-income section, and submit with days to spare instead of on 22 October
common_rejection_risks: Choosing a distance, semi-presential, special titulacion, postgraduate or post-degree programme, or one the institution labels a special study plan - all are explicitly excluded
Your NEM not being available on the Mineduc certificates portal, which blocks socioeconomic and academic evaluation
The target institution not being accredited as at 31 December 2026, or an unaccredited Medicine, Dentistry or Pedagogy degree
Having already held Mineduc arancel scholarships as a first-year student on two separate occasions
A continuation degree unrelated to your technical career, which the Mineduc page requires to be in an afine field of knowledge
Assuming a separate BAR form exists - there is none, and missing the FUAS window means waiting for the next cycle
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The matricula (enrolment fee), which the arancel excludes by definition; any part of the annual arancel above CLP 750,000; living, transport and study costs; and any programme-type exclusions that make you ineligible altogether.
document_audit: The FUAS computes household income from the whole family group including minors, older adults and people with disabilities, so gather every member's situation beforehand
Hold your certificado de egreso or titulacion ready, since Ayuda Mineduc requires it at enrolment
If your secondary-school records predate the online portal, request the certificate in advance rather than during the results stage
Keep proof of enrolment at the accredited institution, as assignment depends on being matriculated
alerts: The window is three weeks long (1-22 October 2026) and the FUAS is the only door - there is no late route published for this first period
Socioeconomic information is not published until 17 December 2026 and assignment until 10 March 2027, so any tuition decision you make before then is provisional
The 70% RSH rule and the two-times first-year exclusion are hard filters, not scoring items - verify both before investing effort
The ChileAtiende page currently lists only the first application period for admission 2027, so watch the official agenda for any further period
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the FUAS online once during 1-22 October 2026, then socioeconomic validation, preselection results (15 January 2027), enrolment with your egreso/titulacion certificate, assignment results (10 March 2027), and the 10-25 March 2027 appeal window if needed.
